Trump pledges $5,000 payments if Republicans win US midterm elections

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has pledged to give $5,000 to every American adult if the Republican party wins control of Congress in the upcoming midterm elections. The promise, referred to as a 'Trump Dividend,' was made during a Republican midterm convention in Dallas. Trump's political action committee (PAC) has also reportedly allocated $49 million to key midterm races. Some coverage questions the legality and nature of this promise, referring to it as 'vote bait' or 'American freebies,' while others highlight it as a potentially significant campaign strategy.
